name: e-labay-tooling
description: Firebase CLI, emulator and security-rules test tooling for E-Labay (the app itself is Flutter).

scripts.test:app: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage "node tests/seed/seed-emulators.mjs --minimal && flutter test integration_test -d emulator-5554 --dart-define=USE_FIREBASE_EMULATORS=true"
scripts.deploy:blaze: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase deploy --only firestore,storage,functions
